title: Text is All You Need for Vision-Language Model Jailbreaking
reasoning: The paper presents a technical jailbreak attack method (Text-DJ) targeting the OCR capabilities of Vision-Language Models. While the evaluation uses safety benchmarks involving categories like violence and hate speech, the research focuses on the efficacy of the adversarial attack itself rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning. Religious topics are explicitly listed only as part of a dataset for 'distraction queries' used to confuse the model.
